title: Softmax
statement: Implement `softmax(logits)` for a non-empty list of finite logits. Subtract the max logit before exponentiating, then divide by the sum of exponentials. The outputs must be positive and sum to 1. This is the distribution a classifier or attention head predicts.

hints: Equal logits must produce a uniform distribution.
Do not use a plain sum of exp on raw logits when one value is huge.

approaches.name: Max-shifted exp
approaches.explanation: Softmax is shift-invariant. Subtracting the max keeps every exp argument ≤ 0.

editorial: Softmax turns logits z into probabilities pᵢ = e^(zᵢ) / Σⱼ e^(zⱼ). Adding a constant to every logit does not change p, so subtracting the maximum logit is exact, not an approximation, and it prevents overflow. The Jacobian of softmax is diag(p) − p pᵀ, which combines with cross-entropy into the beautifully simple gradient p − y. Attention uses the same map on scaled dot products.
reference_solution:
import math

def softmax(logits: list[float]) -> list[float]:
    m = max(logits)
    exps = [math.exp(z - m) for z in logits]
    s = sum(exps)
    return [e / s for e in exps]
